correctness.rationale: A positive atom comes only from three picks on one exposed side. Repeated-side pair has exact density 2(a-d)/a^2, and adjacent-side altitude z sin(theta), giving the explicit product logarithm. Nonadjacent pairs are O(t); three distinct sides have only endpoint-coincidence zeros of a nonnegative multi-affine area determinant and contribute o(t log(1/t)). The cyclic coefficient and scaling were independently checked.
